issue_context.title: [RIP-57] Add example tiered storage backend service provider
issue_context.body:
link to #5754 

As stated in the title, this issue aims to add a POSIX provider for tiered storage. It transfers message data from the default store directory to the mount point of storage medium for tiered storage. This provider is fully functional but for demonstration purposes only.
comments: There is a widely use of filePath in the rocketmq project. The rename operation which not only brings compatibility issues but also conflicts with the naming style of the rocketmq project. It is recommended to revert this change.

review_comments: The maximum length for a file name is 255 bytes on Linux. And it is 4096 bytes for the file path. This length is enough, no need to worry.
According to readme, It seems that `PosixFileSegment` is just an example, there should be more comments to illustrate it.
Could we use Java SPI mechanism to get the implementation?

The SPI mechanism is not applicable in this case. We want users to build their own provider by extending TieredFileSegment, which is an abstract class, not an interface. And tiered storage will create multiple file segment instances in multiple threads. It's more suitable to use the class name to initialize the file segment objects directly.
